zoom.description: Zoom preset (two-way: the toolbar writes the user's choice back). Each preset sets the horizontal density, the paging span and the snap granularity. 'shift' is a day-wide window whose lower ticks/gridlines sit on the config.shifts boundaries; it requires config.shifts and is otherwise treated as 'day'.

showToolbar.description: Show the toolbar (title, zoom presets, navigation).

timezone.description: IANA zone for display (e.g. America/Chicago). Converts event instants and today/now to that zone; empty = browser-local. The time scale itself is epoch-linear, so DST days render as 23/25 hours.

locale.description: Locale for the axis labels (empty = browser/session default). Also selects the built-in UI-text language (see config.labels).

refreshSeconds.description: Re-render every N seconds so the now-line ticks live (0 = off).

loading.description: Bind to your query state for a stale-while-revalidate loading bar.

refetchDebounceMs.description: Coalesce rapid navigation into one visibleStart/End write (0 = immediate).

labels.description: Override the UI text (for translation or branding). Defaults follow config.locale for supported languages (en, fr, de, es, nl, it, pt); each set value replaces that key. (No schema defaults on purpose: values are supplied by the locale packs at runtime; a set value overrides.)

previous.description: Accessible label of the back arrow.

next.description: Accessible label of the forward arrow.

zoomShift.description: Shift zoom-preset button (shown when config.shifts is set).

noResources.description: Empty text when config.resources is empty.

thisEvent.description: Editor: apply-to choice for one occurrence of a recurring series.

allEvents.description: Editor: apply-to choice for the whole recurring series.

timesIn.description: Editor timezone hint; {tz} = the configured timezone.

invalidRange.description: Editor validation hint shown (and Save disabled) when the end is not after the start.

on.description: Repeat end mode: until a date.

after.description: Repeat end mode: after N occurrences.

times.description: Suffix after the occurrence count ("After N times").

exportCsv.description: Tooltip + accessible label of the CSV export button.

previousMonth.description: Accessible label of the mini-nav back arrow.

nextMonth.description: Accessible label of the mini-nav forward arrow.

categories.description: Category definitions: [{id, label, color, icon}]. An event's `category` supplies its colour and optional icon (Ignition icon path, e.g. material/build).

resources.description: The rows: [{id, label, group?, color?, icon?}], rendered in array order. Consecutive equal `group` values share one sticky section header.

group.description: Optional section header (e.g. a line or area).

showLegend.description: Show the category legend (bottom). Only appears when categories are defined; click an item to filter that category.

editable.description: Allow editing gestures: drag a bar to retime it, drag it onto another row to reassign, drag an edge to resize. Every gesture only FIRES onChange — your handler writes back to the data source.

selectable.description: Allow dragging an empty span on a row to create (fires onSelect, or opens the built-in editor with builtInEditor).

builtInEditor.description: Built-in editor popover — for create (with selectable) and click-to-edit/delete (with editable). Recurring occurrences are not editable in place (recurrence is display-only for now); clicking one fires onEventClick instead.

showExport.description: Toolbar button that downloads the loaded events (windowed + recurring definitions) as timeline-events.csv.

weekStart.description: First day of the week in the mini month navigator (title popover).

collapsedGroups.description: Group names whose sections are collapsed (two-way: clicking a group header writes the user's choice back). Set it to open a view pre-collapsed, or bind it to drive/persist the state. Collapse is keyed on the group NAME, so a group split into multiple sections collapses everywhere.

shifts.description: Shift definitions (zone-local start times) enabling the 'shift' zoom preset: its lower tick row and gridlines sit on these boundaries, labelled with the shift names. Example: [{label: 'Early', start: '06:00'}, {label: 'Late', start: '14:00'}, {label: 'Night', start: '22:00'}].

label.description: Shift name shown on the tick (e.g. 'Early').

start.description: Start of the shift as a zone-local wall time 'HH:mm' (e.g. '06:00').

data.description: The controlled event data. The timeline never mutates it — editing gestures fire onChange and your handler writes back.

events.description: Events/bars: [{id, resourceId, title, start, end, category?, color?, status?, description?, display?, rrule?}]. `display`: 'bar' (default), 'state' (full-height contiguous band) or 'background' (shaded span). For DB-backed timelines, bind a query scoped by output.visibleStart/visibleEnd.

recurringEvents.description: Always-loaded recurring definitions (WHERE rrule IS NOT NULL), merged with `events` so a windowed query never drops a series.

visibleStart.description: Start of the visible window as an ISO-8601 UTC instant (half-open [start, end)) — bind your query: ts >= visibleStart AND ts < visibleEnd.

visibleEnd.description: End of the visible window as an ISO-8601 UTC instant (exclusive).

hiddenCategories.description: Category ids currently filtered out via the legend (read-only).
